Scope: a passenger station for the SAR railway at Sudair Industrial City (platform, canopy, finishes and station electrical, CCTV and voice evacuation systems) with its access roads RD-01 and RD-02 and their storm water, sewer, potable water, street lighting, telecom and MV/LV networks.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. At 26-Oct-2026 the project is 27.3% complete against 40.0% planned, 12.7% behind (SPI 0.68). This week it gained 1.2% against 1.9% planned, so the gap widened by 0.7%.

Procurement and the station works are holding the project back. Procurement is 19.2% complete against 80.0% planned. The station package (platform, canopy and station systems) has not started: 0% against 9.4% planned, because the SAR fence permission and the client's canopy and platform design are still outstanding. Roads and utilities are closer to plan at 30.7% against 34.2%. To finish by 06-Aug-2027 the project needs about 1.8% a week for the remaining 40 weeks; this week it achieved 1.2%.

Data notes

  • No earlier weekly report has been uploaded for this project (W01 to W03 are empty), so the this-week quantity column shows "–". This week's physical progress and the 19-Oct-2026 values come from the weekly and previous-week columns of the 26-Oct-2026 Progress sheet.
  • The cover sheet's headline "Earn Value" and its SPI are cost-based (BOQ value), not physical progress, and are not used in this report.
  • Planned progress at 26-Oct-2026 is 40.0% on the Progress sheet but 38.4% on the Physical-Chart Data sheet. That sheet's percentage column for April and May (4.24% and 8.17%) does not match its own man-hours, so the S-curve uses man-hours divided by the 638,468 man-hour budget.
  • Mobilisation shows 19,793 man-hours planned and earned against a budget of 19,154, and Engineering 32,988 planned against 31,923, both 103.3%.
  • Weekly planned man-hours for Road Works 1 (17,222) do not equal the sum of Road-01 and Road-02 (2,412), and Low Voltage Road-02 shows −11,285 planned this week.
  • Major Quantities: aggregate base course is 21,459 m³ against a total of 16,376 m³, and HDPE pipe and LV cables are 100% finished, out of line with the Progress sheet. The asphalt total is 13,360 m³ there but 3,420 m³ on the Procurement sheet; curbstone is in m² there and in m on the Procurement sheet.
  • The Procurement sheet gives kerbstone a completion rate of 1.4 (140%).
  • Manpower: the October plan is 217 in the monthly histogram but 60 in the weekly summary panel.
  • The cover sheet gives "Revised Completion" as 07-Apr-2026, the site handover date. The MV works milestone has a baseline of 22-May-2027 on the cover sheet and 12-May-2027 on the Milestones sheet.
  • P6 finishes the project on 07-Aug-2027 with −0.5 days of float, one day after the contract date; the weekly report forecasts 06-Aug-2027 with no variance.
  • The HSE inspection sheet and the FIR summary carry project ID SUD1-02-011, and the Conclusion sheet describes a different project (Sudair infrastructure networks, Phase 2 Part 2). The FIR summary total is 3,646,339 SAR at the top and 3,923,633 SAR at the bottom.
  • The risk register describes the project as ahead of schedule, which the physical progress figures do not support. Risks 3120-4 and 3120-5 are marked Open in one column and Close in another.
  • Photo 2 is captioned "Bituminous base course MC-01 at Road 1" in the workbook and "backfilling for roundabout at MC20 with road 1" in the PDF.
